# ghost/chrome

Google Chrome without an account: open a URL, search the web, open an Incognito tab, read the current page, count matches with Find in page.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/chrome
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/chrome open_url --device <serial> --param url=<url>
ghost skill run ghost/chrome search_web --device <serial> --param query=<query>
ghost skill run ghost/chrome open_incognito_tab --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/chrome get_page_info --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/chrome find_in_page --device <serial> --param text=<text>
```

## Actions

- `open_url`: Open wikipedia.org in Chrome
- `search_web`: Search the web for android automation
- `open_incognito_tab`: Open an incognito tab
- `get_page_info`: What page is open in Chrome?
- `find_in_page`: How many times does 'domain' appear on this page?
